Public Health Training — Survey Hub

Use this hub to route participants to the correct survey and display QR codes on slides or handouts.

  • 👉 Immediate Post-Session Survey
    Focus: participant experience, aligned objectives, presenter, ROI.

  • 👉 Six-Month Follow-Up Survey
    Focus: retention, application, long-term usefulness.

Pro tip: quick link override (no file edits)

Append a ?url= query parameter to prefill the destination form link.

Examples

  • Immediate:
    https://arshah18.github.io/surveys/immediate/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fforms.gle%2FREPLACE_IMMEDIATE
  • Six-month:
    https://arshah18.github.io/surveys/six-month/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fforms.gle%2FREPLACE_SIX_MONTH
